title: Support legacy iOS 12 Safari
body:
Change: support-legacy-ios-12-safari

The OpenSpec change support-legacy-ios-12-safari is already prepared in openspec/changes/support-legacy-ios-12-safari/ (proposal, specs, design, tasks). Do not create a new change.

specify: run the openspec-propose procedure against this existing change. Re-check every claim it makes about the code against the current main and fix what is stale. Keep its scope and decisions. Leave it the only active change.

Goal: the app starts and its main jobs work on iOS Safari 12.5 (iPhone 5s/6, iPad Air / mini 2–3), while modern browsers are unaffected.

Key points (details in the change):

Production syntax lowered to Safari 12. Polyfills load only on engines that lack the built-ins, and modern browsers download none at start.
No BigInt at run time; a CI check enforces it.
Legacy zone shim: renamed zones (Europe/Kyiv) work through the legacy name. Stored IDs stay canonical.
Day track tap and card reorder by finger work without Pointer Events.
The app checks for a new version again when it returns to the screen, at most once per 15 minutes.
CI checks: Safari 12 syntax, no inset shorthand in CSS, no BigInt in sources.
The initial JS of the modern build stays within 150 KB gzipped.
Open item for the spike (design D3): whether the shim also covers PlainDateTime#toZonedDateTime with disambiguation, used by resolveWallClock. A later change (add-wall-time-input-with-hint) depends on it, so include it in the spike.

Out of scope: dark theme, country names and smooth track dragging on iOS 12 (see the proposal's Non-Goals).

decisions.body:
The other active changes under openspec/changes/ (add-wall-time-input-with-hint, set-home-location-and-show-differences, show-here-entry-for-device-time) are prepared work for later tasks. They stay exactly as they are, in main and on this branch. Do not edit, move or delete them.

"Leave it the only active change" in the brief is outdated. It means: do not create a new change, and do not touch the other ones. It does not mean the others must be removed. Work only in openspec/changes/support-legacy-ios-12-safari/.

Review only this change. The presence of other active changes is expected and is neither a finding nor a note.
